name: Tinsel & Timber
summary:
Tinsel & Timber is a Christmas tree farm game set across the days of advent. Each in-game day the player opens a door on an advent calendar, fells trees in a snowy forest and then picks and decorates trees with ornaments, lights, garlands and toppers to suit the tastes of animal neighbours who come to the lot.

Evenings are spent in a small village with shops, sledding, skating, wreath-making and gingerbread baking, a cabin to furnish, pets and a photo mode, while twelve neighbours each follow their own storyline through to Christmas Eve. An optional advent calendar mode ties progress to the real date, opening one door per day from 1 December.
